description: Is a business on anybody's list? Give its `name`, and any of `domain`, `state` (two letters), `number` (state entity number) and `ein`. Answers with `standing` (flagged, incomplete or clear; clear only when every list was checked and found nothing), the `findings` behind it, and each section: US Treasury OFAC sanctions (SDN and consolidated, aliases included), GLEIF LEI records, SEC EDGAR filers, state registry status (OpenCorporates) and SAM.gov exclusions when keyed, and the domain over RDAP plus Spamhaus/URIBL/SURBL/Safe Browsing when the operator enabled them. A name match is not an identity: confirm against address and identifiers.

ein.description: US EIN, kept to identify it, never checked (optional)

state.description: Two-letter US state it is registered in (optional), e.g. CA

name: business_standing
